statement: The source implementations do not validate retail 2026 Puck receiver attachment ordering, pairing, bond persistence, slot-local output while absent, player indicators, USB descriptors, multi-slot simultaneous failures or real receiver unplug behavior. Keep the existing sc2-gap-puck-slots and sc2-gap-puck-usb-descriptors gaps open for owner-operated measurements.
